_note: Raised-alarm INPUTS for the ANCA Mate starter kit — the alarm catalogue. This is what the alarm system emits; a QR code / URL carries an instance of one of these (its code, plus the runtime env/context described in the interface contract). It deliberately does NOT contain the resolution: producing that from the documentation is ANCA Mate's job. Curated example answers live in reference-answers.json.

_identifier_convention.status: Draft v2 (working convention for this PoC; see the Alarm Identifier Convention doc)
_identifier_convention.origin: owning namespace — 'am' = ANCA Motion core platform; OEMs use their own (e.g. 'amt')
_identifier_convention.module: short architecture token or app name (controlled vocabulary, <=6 chars, lowercase)
_identifier_convention.sequence: zero-padded integer, flat within each origin+module
_identifier_convention.delimiter: dots are used here for the PoC; production would use a non-dot delimiter (the alarm system reserves dots for property names)

_severity_scale.description: Severity is an integer 1-1000, subdivided into bands with the default values shown.

_schema.title: short display name / message resource
_schema.alarm_text: the literal message shown on the machine (locale-dependent) — an optional hint, not the key
_schema.description: optional fixed description of the condition, in the documentation's own terms: what went wrong, when, and the areas the fix can involve. Used to search the documentation in place of the title and alarm_text. No per-occurrence values, no steps
_schema.data_fields: example structured data an instance of this alarm could carry

alarms.title: Electronic cam axes on different logical machines
alarms.alarm_text: PPI Execution Error — Program mdi1.pp, line 2: The X and A axes must be attached to the same logical machine before they can be linked by an Electronic Cam.
alarms.description: A part program tried to link two axes with an Electronic Cam while the axes were attached to different logical machines. Related areas: electronic cam functions, and attaching or transferring an axis between logical machines.

alarms.title: Axis attached to another logical machine
alarms.alarm_text: PPI Execution Error — Program mdi1.pp, line 1: Cannot attach the x' axis to logical machine 1 — it is currently attached to logical machine 2.
alarms.description: A part program tried to attach an axis to a logical machine while the axis was still attached to another logical machine. Related areas: the attach and detach functions, and transferring an axis between logical machines.

alarms.title: M-code part program could not be activated
alarms.alarm_text: PPI Execution Error — Program mdi1.pp, line 1: Could not activate part program 'm101.pp' for M-code M101.
alarms.description: An M-code that is configured to run as a part program could not be executed because its program file could not be found or activated. Related areas: the M-code mode configured for the M-code (part program or PLC), and the part program search hierarchy.

alarms.title: Not enough points in spline
alarms.alarm_text: PPI Execution Error — Program mdi1.pp, line 4: Spline requires at least 3 control points.
alarms.description: A spline was programmed with too few control points between the commands that start and end the spline. Related areas: spline interpolation, the splineon and splineoff commands, and spline control points.

alarms.title: Multiple class 1 preparatory words in a block
alarms.alarm_text: PPI Execution Error — Program mdi1.pp, line 1: Only one class 1 preparatory word is allowed per block.
alarms.description: A part program block contains more than one class 1 preparatory word (G-code). Related areas: preparatory word classes, class 1 preparatory words, and part program block structure.

alarms.title: Logical device mapped multiple times
alarms.alarm_text: Startup halted: logical device 5 is mapped to more than one joint.
alarms.description: At startup the configuration assigns the same logical device to more than one joint, so the system cannot start. Related areas: the joint logical device parameter, logical device addresses, and setting up devices and joints.

alarms.title: OPC UA server not licensed
alarms.alarm_text: OPC UA Server: the current license does not include the OPC UA server option. Purchase the option, or disable the server with the "opcua.enable" configuration property.
alarms.description: The OPC UA server is enabled in the configuration but the installed license does not include the OPC UA server option. Related areas: the configuration property that enables the OPC UA server, and licensing options.

alarms.title: EtherCAT device in unexpected state
alarms.alarm_text: Fieldbus: device 'Drive_3' (station 0x03) is in an unexpected state — actual SAFEOP, expected OP.
alarms.description: An EtherCAT device is not in the state the master expects, for example it stays in a lower state when it should be operational. Related areas: EtherCAT device states, the device unexpected state error, and reinitialising the EtherCAT bus.

alarms.title: Drive emergency (EMCY)
alarms.alarm_text: Fieldbus: emergency reported by drive 'Drive_3' — error code 0x2350, error register 0x04.
alarms.description: A drive on the EtherCAT fieldbus sent a CANopen over EtherCAT emergency message with an error code and error register. Related areas: the emergency error, manufacturer-specific error data, and recovering the drive.

alarms.title: EtherCAT frame response error
alarms.alarm_text: Fieldbus: frame response error (CRC) on cyclic task 1 — 3 cyclic frames lost.
alarms.description: An EtherCAT frame was malformed, unanswered or lost on a cyclic or acyclic task. Related areas: the frame response error and its error types, and the fieldbus log files.

alarms.title: Device firmware mismatch
alarms.alarm_text: Fieldbus: device 'Drive_3' is running firmware 1.2.0 but 1.4.0 is expected.
alarms.description: The firmware version an EtherCAT device is running differs from the firmware version the configuration expects. Related areas: device firmware upgrade, the expected firmware version, and the fieldbus state required for an upload.
